  "practices": [
    {"id": "p1", "text": "It is recommended that instances of the DCAT main classes have a global identifier, and use of blank nodes is generally discouraged when encoding DCAT in RDF.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "any", "grounding_span": "it is recommended that instances of the DCAT main classes have a global identifier, and use of blank nodes is generally discouraged when encoding DCAT in RDF.", "location": "5.2"},
    {"id": "p2", "text": "Information about licenses and rights SHOULD be provided on the level of Distribution.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "Information about licenses and rights *SHOULD* be provided on the level of Distribution.", "location": "6.6"},
    {"id": "p3", "text": "If distributions are accessible only through a landing page, the landing page link SHOULD be duplicated as dcat:accessURL on a distribution.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "the landing page link *SHOULD* be duplicated as `dcat:accessURL` on a distribution.", "location": "6.4.17"},
    {"id": "p4", "text": "dcat:downloadURL SHOULD be used for the URL at which a distribution is available directly, typically through an HTTP Get request.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "`dcat:downloadURL` *SHOULD* be used for the URL at which this distribution is available directly, typically through a HTTP Get request.", "location": "6.8.11"},
    {"id": "p5", "text": "A checksum must be provided via a route that is separate from the data it sums.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "any", "grounding_span": "A checksum must, however, be provided via a route that is separate from the data it sums.", "location": "17"},
    {"id": "p6", "text": "It is recommended that spatial-coverage links point to entries in a well maintained gazetteer such as Geonames.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "It is recommended that links are to entries in a well maintained gazetteer such as Geonames.", "location": "6.6.4"},
    {"id": "p7", "text": "Use the non-versioned IRI to express conformance; if a specific version is needed, use both the un-versioned and versioned IRI.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "any", "grounding_span": "Use the non-versioned IRI. If you need to express conformance with a specific version of the standard / specification, use both the un-versioned and the versioned IRI.", "location": "14.2.1"},
    {"id": "p8", "text": "To support data citation, the dataset description should include at a minimum the dataset identifier, creator(s), title, publisher and publication/release date.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "the dataset description should include at a minimum: the dataset identifier, the dataset creator(s), the dataset title, the dataset publisher and the dataset publication or release date.", "location": "13"},
    {"id": "p9", "text": "It is important to enforce alternative text for non-text data resources through DCAT profile mechanisms or authoring systems.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "it is important to enforce alternative text for non-text data resources through the DCAT profile mechanisms or systems supporting the creation and editing of such data", "location": "18"},
    {"id": "p10", "text": "The release date property SHOULD be set using the first known date of issuance.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "This property *SHOULD* be set using the first known date of issuance.", "location": "6.4.7"},
    {"id": "p11", "text": "It is recommended to use canonical IRIs of well-known licenses such as those defined by Creative Commons.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "dataset", "grounding_span": "it is recommended to use canonical IRIs of well-known licenses such as those defined by Creative Commons.", "location": "9"},
    {"id": "p12", "text": "Make DCAT data and metadata files downloadable from authoritative HTTPS origins, and provide any checksums via a separate channel from the data they represent.", "as_of_date": "2024-08-22", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "make DCAT data and metadata files downloadable from authoritative HTTPS origins, and provide any checksums via a separate channel from the data they represent.", "location": "17"}
